verdict.rationale: Version-control friendliness is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack addresses text-based or diffable scene formats, scene merging, VCS integration, or built-in multi-user collaboration. The nearest items are that imported assets are cached under res://.godot/imported/ and that scripts can be edited in external text editors, and neither shows the project format plays well with version control or team merging.
